title.narrative: Establishment of a Technology and Creative Industries Hub in Kapan

description.narrative: The aim of the Action is to establish a technology and creative industries hub in Kapan by replicating the TUMO education center model. This hub will implement an non-formal education and entrepreneurship program in creative technologies that will focus on youth (12-18 years old) to impart fundamental skills early on that can support their future development, extend to employment age adults (18 years old +), to foster their business and leadership skills.
